decision_rule: An IntAct row is an automatic positive candidate only when its interaction type is exactly MI:0407 and at least one non-obsolete detection-method term is in the generated auto-accept set. Protein three-hybrid and x-ray powder/fiber diffraction are manually reviewed even though they descend from an accepted root. MI:0407 descendants, unlisted experimental methods, obsolete terms, and ambiguous multi-valued fields enter manual review. Generic physical association or association is never auto-accepted.
scientific_scope: Conservative high-precision seed benchmark for direct heterotypic human protein-protein interactions; this is not a claim that excluded records are non-interactions.
